review.notes: Complete native duckdb_functions, duckdb_tables and duckdb_views exports through the actual attached worker, cross-checked against worker.py registration. Three functions and one reference view; view is a queryable logical table surface and is retained in denominator with VIEW signature. No authentication or write capabilities are registered or excluded. Public source and release names/signatures match; publication changes notebooks only.

review.purpose: Select a model family and explainer before training the example forest.
review.finding: The three-family reference identifies RandomForest as TreeExplainer/exact. The notebook selects and asserts that row before training, while distinguishing exact attribution from model accuracy and from other families’ reference assumptions.

review.purpose: Explain each prediction with signed, name-aligned feature contributions.
review.finding: Three contributions for each of 33 input IDs reconstruct independent worker predictions within 1e-8 minutes. Default local values are approximately +19.07,-3.90,-5.16 minutes; they are model accounting, not causal effects.

review.purpose: Establish the reference from which signed local attributions reconstruct a prediction.
review.finding: One regression base with no class label is approximately 54.79 minutes. Adding local SHAP produces the 64.79-minute prediction. This is the tree-path reference, not a prediction for an average or zero-valued trip.

review.purpose: Contrast cohort mean-absolute SHAP with the magnitude of one trip’s signed contributions.
review.finding: Across 32 fixed synthetic rows distance ranks first at approximately 12.65 minutes, followed by rain4.12 and stops3.64. SQL recomputation from long SHAP matches all three worker importance rows; the cohort interpretation is kept distinct from local effects and forecasting quality.
